response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.telescregistry AS tele, o.weathprofile AS wp, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS baseline FROM g) SELECT g.wp AS weathprofile, AVG(g.avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(g.avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(g.avg_mod - b.baseline) AS avg_excess_over_baseline FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline GROUP BY g.wp
